content:
B"H

# REMAINING WORK — Universal Portal + Stable UI + Production Repair

The Awtsmoos renews every route, datum, control, and deployment from nothing into sight;
Awtsmoos.com must therefore join calm human interfaces to universal resource contracts and prove them live in production light.

## Current Mission State

### Completed Architecture / Source Foundations

- [x] Three planning/critique passes completed and preserved without overwrite.
- [x] Actual API federation/router patterns inspected from real files.
- [x] Existing social entity, relationship, activity, provenance, Drive-resource, schema, and UI-foundation patterns inspected.
- [x] Compatibility-first Portal architecture chosen: existing domain APIs remain authoritative; Portal adapts rather than silently breaking them.
- [x] Universal resource envelope contract implemented with forward-compatible extensions.
- [x] Namespaced/versioned type contract implemented.
- [x] Action, relationship, bounded-query, structured-error, provenance, job, and transformation contracts implemented.
- [x] Portal limits/primitives implemented.
- [x] Deterministic type registry, built-in types, and capability-root modules implemented.
- [x] First real compatibility adapter implemented over the existing ApiFamilyCatalog abstraction.
- [x] Read-only Portal service, handlers, route family, and API-family catalog registration implemented.
- [x] Universal UI stabilization begun with calm neutral tokens, solid actions, fields, choices, feedback, motion, prose, lists, tables, media/code, and semantic-structure fallbacks.

## Production Blockers — Highest Priority

- [ ] Reproduce the user's live `https://awtsmoos.com/apps/` failures from production HTTP/browser evidence.
- [ ] Trace and repair `GET /scripts/awtsmoos/ui/foundation.js?v=universal-ui-001` returning 404.
- [ ] Trace and repair `/apps/scripts/apps-filter.js?...` returning `application/json` to a module request in production.
- [ ] Prove local and production module requests return JavaScript MIME with successful status.
- [ ] Prove `/apps/` has zero site-owned runtime exceptions, failed module loads, or unintended static 404s after deployment.
- [ ] Separate browser-extension `mises_safe_injected` / ethereum noise from site-owned failures.

## Universal UI Work Still Required

- [ ] Complete `responsive.css` for small-screen dialogs/sheets, safe areas, long content, navigation, tables, and mobile viewport behavior.
- [ ] Rewrite `geelooy/style/universal-ui.css` completely with the final deterministic import order.
- [ ] Re-read every universal-ui source file completely after the final first pass.
- [ ] Ensure every touched CSS source file remains under 120 lines and uses tab indentation where indentation exists.
- [ ] Verify no futuristic default gradients/glass/glow remain in the universal fallback layer.
- [ ] Extend runtime UI auditing for navigation-list markers, dialog labels, viewport-escaping code/pre, target sizing, accessible names, and horizontal overflow.

## Portal Client / UX Work Still Required

- [ ] Build `PortalApiClient` and resource normalization client modules.
- [ ] Build deterministic renderer-selection/registry modules.
- [ ] Build semantic field registry and bounded unknown-value renderer.
- [ ] Build generic, collection, API-family, unknown, and developer-inspector renderers.
- [ ] Build `/portal/` as a calm mobile-first real surface over the live Portal API.
- [ ] Make `/portal/` browse real registered types and real API-family resources.
- [ ] Make unknown types render safely before specialized renderer code exists.
- [ ] Add Resource Inspector showing type, ID, schema, links, capabilities, metadata, extensions, and renderer choice.
- [ ] Keep API-provided presentation semantic-only; never execute server-supplied HTML/CSS/module paths.

## API / Data Platform Work Still Required

- [ ] Add contract tests for minimal/maximal envelopes, unknown fields, malformed types/actions/queries, error resources, provenance, jobs, and transformations.
- [ ] Add adapter-equivalence tests proving legacy API-family identity/path/description survive Portal adaptation.
- [ ] Add registry/capability-root tests.
- [ ] Add actual HTTP probes for `/api/portal/`, `/types`, `/type`, `/api-families`, and `/api-family`.
- [ ] Inspect and add additional real domain adapters only where current authorization/contracts are proven: Drive/files, social entities/activity, forms, typed tools/jobs.
- [ ] Do not advertise fake executable actions/jobs/transforms without a real authorized backend.

## Whole-Site UI / Runtime Work

- [ ] Finish and run the runtime-quality audit against `/apps/`, `/portal/`, and representative page families.
- [ ] Run mobile 360/390, tablet 768, desktop 1440, and cinema 1920 viewport verification on representative complex pages.
- [ ] Audit public routes for module MIME failures, static 404s, uncaught errors, root overflow, unstyled native-risk controls, and missing accessible names.
- [ ] Repair every current site-owned failure with complete-file rewrites only.
- [ ] Preserve specialist game/editor/media identity while sharing safe controls/errors/accessibility/mobile foundations.

## Mandatory Readback / Delta

- [ ] Read every file touched by this mission completely after the implementation pass.
- [ ] Write a new first-pass DELTA comparing all plans with actual source.
- [ ] Rewrite complete files for every discovered delta.
- [ ] Re-read all touched files again.
- [ ] Run line-count/tab/JSDoc/import/export/cycle/public-contract checks.

## Verification

- [ ] Run syntax checks for every touched JS/MJS source.
- [ ] Run relevant existing tests plus new Portal/UI/runtime regressions.
- [ ] Run API HTTP probes on the local server.
- [ ] Run local Chrome console/network/runtime checks with cache disabled.
- [ ] Run static asset and JavaScript MIME checks.
- [ ] Verify no unrelated regression in `/api/catalog`.

## Git / Deployment

- [ ] Capture fresh full Git status, branch, HEAD, remotes, and concurrent-agent changes.
- [ ] Classify every changed path as this mission, user work, concurrent-agent work, generated artifact, local-only artifact, or secret-risk.
- [ ] Preserve and include all safe unrelated work as explicitly requested; never publish secrets/local hazardous artifacts blindly.
- [ ] Inspect the repository's real deployment mechanism from config/scripts/workflows.
- [ ] Commit the complete safe requested tree.
- [ ] Push canonical GitHub branch.
- [ ] Verify remote branch HEAD equals local HEAD.
- [ ] Execute the real deployment mechanism.
- [ ] Verify deployed commit/version where observable.
- [ ] Re-run `/apps/`, `/portal/`, Portal API, and representative runtime/UI audits against `https://awtsmoos.com/`.
- [ ] Give the user only a URL that has been directly verified after deployment.

## NEXT_ACTION

Read the current `/apps` entry/module paths and `/scripts/awtsmoos/ui` tree, then probe local and production HTTP responses for the exact failing URLs before rewriting any responsible source file.
